name: complete
description: Assert that current tool-assisted or planned work is done. Call once with a short summary, after the last tool action and after every plan step is done or skipped. Tool-assisted turns and turns that create or update a plan (including resume / goal-mode turns) require this call; plain no-tool Q&A does not. The runtime reopens the turn if current plan steps remain pending, running, or failed. A plan carried from an earlier turn binds only after this turn updates it. Any later tool action, including `plan` or `plan_update`, invalidates the assertion, so call `complete` last.

summary.description: What was accomplished (one or two sentences).
